en: The postcard shows a black-and-white image of a large two-story building labeled 'Stöde Nya Folkskolan' with the year '1918' on the roof's front gable. The building appears to be newly constructed, situated in a rural area with another small building in the background and open land. The reverse side of the postcard contains handwritten Swedish text, address lines, and a red postage stamp marked 'SVERIGE' and '10 ORE', along with a postmark.
